claims.text: Rimini Street announced an expanded strategic partnership with American Digital to give SAP licensees a lower-risk path to cloud modernization.
American Digital will serve as a solution partner for Rimini Cloud for SAP to help migrate SAP systems to modern cloud infrastructure.
The offering lets customers move to modern cloud infrastructure without ERP reimplementation or converting perpetual licenses to subscriptions.
This expansion builds on a strategic alliance established in 2025 combining Rimini Street and American Digital capabilities.

evidence.quote: Rimini Street, the Software Support and Agentic AI ERP Company™ and the leading third-party support provider for Oracle, SAP and VMware software, today announced an expanded strategic partnership with American Digital Corporation to give SAP licensees a lower-risk, more flexible path to cloud modernization.

Through the expanded relationship, American Digital will serve as a solution partner for Rimini Cloud™ for SAP, helping SAP ECC and S/4HANA licensees move their existing SAP systems to modern cloud infrastructure
without requiring ERP reimplementation or conversion of perpetual licenses to subscriptions, while maintaining greater control over their long-term roadmap.

The announcement builds on a strategic alliance established in 2025 that brings together Rimini Street’s enterprise software support, managed services and ERP innovation expertise with American Digital’s infrastructure, cloud migration and managed services capabilities.
